text_simplified: A parent must avoid contradicting his words with his actions. He should not command his children to be truthful while lying in front of them, nor forbid them from backbiting, smoking, or harmful late nights while engaging in those habits himself. For advice is only accepted and beneficial when the educator begins with himself and restrains himself from error.
